rv.q: A killer performance, all in all, as backed by Aguilar and the other Broadway-quality principals.
The production was exceptional in every sense of the word and left me speechless, struggling to describe how much I enjoyed it.
This joyous, powerful, heartfelt biographical story is sure to bring audiences to their feet clapping, dancing and singing along.
This marvelous production is everything you could hope for.
And given the extraordinary quality of the production that Stearns co-directs with Brenda Didier, it very well could be.
Wonderful performances, hot choreo, great costumes and a full-blast band make ‘Jersey Boys’ at Mercury a heavy hitter for the Wrigleyville theater company.
This cast will move you, make you laugh, and leave you dancing and singing your way home.

Tight harmonies, infectious tunes zealously performed by Stearns and Didier’s terrific ensemble make for a hugely entertaining night at the theater, which concludes with Metcalf’s Frankie reminiscing about the music that drives him still.
And thanks to Mercury, this no-stop muscle car of a musical makes for a swell crowd-pleaser.
This version was one to beat the band.
Mercury Theater’s “Jersey Boys” is musical theatre ecstasy.

cn.t: Critics praise this intimate Mercury Theater production as an energetic, highly entertaining crowd-pleaser that brings fresh zing to the jukebox musical, with electrifying performances and Frankie Valli's iconic songbook.
